key_traits.label: Leaves
key_traits.text: Lower leaves opposite, upper alternate; deltate to lanceolate, pinnately toothed to 1-pinnately lobed.

key_traits.label: Flowers
key_traits.text: Male heads in terminal spike-like racemes; female heads clustered below.

key_traits.label: Fruit
key_traits.text: Small obpyramidal to globose burs with 0–6 short distal spines/tubercles.

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: Perennial often forming connected patches from creeping rhizomes; check underground connections only where disturbance is appropriate

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: Lower leaves commonly opposite, upper alternate; blades toothed to deeply lobed, but leaf form varies

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: Terminal elongated clusters of pollen-bearing male heads; small seed-bearing female heads occur below, toward leaf axils

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: Compare annual Ambrosia artemisiifolia: often more finely dissected foliage and no persistent perennial rhizome network; leaf shape alone can overlap

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: Compare giant ragweed A. trifida: much larger broad 3–5-lobed leaves and tall coarse stems; inspect reproductive heads for confirmation
